description: Extract structured data from a rendered page using CSS selectors. Returns text, inner HTML, attributes and geometry for every matched element. Example: browserless_scrape({ url: "https://news.ycombinator.com", elements: [{ selector: ".titleline a" }], _apiKey: "your-token" })

_apiKey.description: Browserless API token (sign up at https://www.browserless.io/signup)

elements.description: Array of selector objects, each { selector: "<css-selector>" }. Uses document.querySelectorAll, so each selector can match many elements.

name: browserless_scrape
